# pve_ceph_releases (Data Source)

Ceph releases known to a node, marking which are installable there.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_ceph_releases" "example" {
node = "pve1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) The cluster node name.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>.
- `releases` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/ceph/releases. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--releases))

<a id="nestedatt--releases"></a>
### Nested Schema for `releases`

Read-Only:

- `available` (Boolean) Whether this release can be installed on this node, that is, it has packages for the node's architecture and current Proxmox VE release.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the release recommended for new installations.
- `release` (String) The Ceph release code name, for example 'squid'.
- `unsupported` (Boolean) Whether this release is not (yet) supported for production use.
- `version` (String) The Ceph release major version, for example '19.2'.
